spec.situation_desc: sent a bank transfer that arrived days late, so they missed a rent payment
spec.vuln_cue: mentions they're having chemotherapy at the moment

utterances.speaker: agent
utterances.text: Good morning, Thistle Bank, Priya speaking. How can I help?

utterances.speaker: customer
utterances.text: Hi, I’m Siobhan MacLeod. I sent a transfer for my rent and it arrived days late. I missed the payment, and I’m really unhappy about it.

utterances.speaker: agent
utterances.text: I can see the £1,250 transfer left your account on 14 October, and your balance is now £86.40. Can you give me your date of birth?

utterances.speaker: customer
utterances.text: It’s 9 March 1987. I’ve already had to explain this to my landlord. I’m having chemotherapy at the moment as well, so it’s been a lot.

utterances.speaker: agent
utterances.text: Right. Was the payment to your landlord’s usual account?

utterances.speaker: customer
utterances.text: Yes, the same account I’ve paid before. It was meant to arrive on the 15th, but they didn’t get it until the 19th.

utterances.speaker: agent
utterances.text: Okay. I’m logging this as a complaint about the delayed transfer and the missed rent payment.

utterances.speaker: customer
utterances.text: Thank you. I want to know why it took so long, and what you’re going to do about the rent charge.

utterances.speaker: agent
utterances.text: I can’t say what the outcome will be. I’ll take ownership of getting the complaint reviewed.

utterances.speaker: customer
utterances.text: All right. I’ve got a £40 late fee from the landlord now.

utterances.speaker: agent
utterances.text: I’ll refer the transfer and that fee for review. I’ll send the complaint team the details today, and I’ll call you by 5pm tomorrow with an update.

utterances.speaker: customer
utterances.text: And when will I get a proper answer?

utterances.speaker: agent
utterances.text: You’ll receive a full written response within 15 business days. The complaint team will review the transfer records and your account of the missed rent payment, then send the response to your address on file.

utterances.speaker: customer
utterances.text: Okay. I’ll wait for your call tomorrow, then.

utterances.speaker: agent
utterances.text: Yes. That’s all I can do today.
